title: Delivery Room after Replacement Shipments on Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy
content:
Replacement shipments lengthen the delivery room of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship: the room left for delivery in the dosing days between its shipments. The count is of free replacement shipments released on that subscription for accepted claims, as its shipment history shows them.

**Rule.** When two or more replacement shipments were released on the subscription in the last twelve months, the delivery room is 9 days. When exactly one was released in that period, it is 5 days. Otherwise the delivery room is not lengthened.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

| Replacement shipments released on the subscription in the last twelve months | Delivery room |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 9 days |
| exactly 1 | 5 days |
| none | not lengthened |

**Hypothetical history.** One replacement released four months ago and one released exactly twelve months ago: only the first counts, so the delivery room is 5 days. Two replacements, both released within the last twelve months: 9 days.
